versions.content: NvProvideComSpec As communication with an NvBlock- SwComponentType is in most cases bi-directional it is also necessary to consider role- specific communication attributes for AbstractProvidedPortPrototype s typed by an NvDataInterface . For this purpose the NvProvideComSpec is defined. The main purpose of this kind of ComSpec is the definition of initial values for the RAM Block and the ROM Block that corresponds to an nvData defined in the context of the NvDataInterface used to type the given AbstractProvidedPortProto- type .
